public voidIo\Poll\Watcher::remove
Removes the watcher from its context. It becomes inactive and is no longer returned by Io\Poll\Context::wait. The handle can be passed to Io\Poll\Context::add again afterwards.
Closing a watched stream removes its watchers automatically. Calling this method on a watcher that was removed that way has no effect.
